text: Arrived in a timely manner but doesn’t work very well .... Arrived in a timely manner but doesn’t work very well. Very slow to register temp and by the time it registers, the medium steaks are well done! I do not recomend this product.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CSG-300, Instant Read Folding Thermometer
features: RAPID RESPONSE: The 4.25" food-grade stainless steel instant read probe needs just 2-3 seconds to measure accurate temperature and has a wide range of -58℉-572℉ (-50°C- 300°C).
WATER RESISTANT: IPX66 rating for water resistance. Takes 1 Lithium battery (included).
LARGE SCREEN: Easy and clear reading display. MAX/MIN button to read the last highest/max temperature measured.
EASY STORAGE: The strong magnetic backing allows you to place it on your grill or refrigerator when not in use; also has hanging hole that can be hung on a tool hook.
CALIBRATION FUNCTION: Adjusts the probe sensor back to the correct accuracy.
